errors.text: The proposed HIP/homogenization intervention cannot materially reduce the alloy's intrinsic density; HIP would generally eliminate porosity and may increase measured bulk density.
It fails to identify the required Cr addition and the resulting reticulated multicomponent Laves phase.
No quantitative density, strength, ductility, or toughness targets are provided.
The falsification rule is non-quantitative and therefore does not satisfy the request for explicit rejection criteria.
The proposed elevated-temperature tensile tests do not match the target room-temperature compression intervention and outcome.
